designNotes: Specification: profile shows plans and logs; one row per set, plan read-only beside actual; Cardio fields differ.

cases.title: A customer's plans and session logs are in the profile, plan and actual on one row

steps.action: Open a customer with a plan and a logged session, tab "Session logs and progress"
steps.expected: Each set is one row with the plan (read-only) and the actual side by side

cases.title: A Cardio exercise shows time, speed and heart rate instead of weights

steps.action: In a session log, choose a Cardio exercise
steps.expected: The row has the fields "time", "speed" and "heart rate" and no weight field
